title.en: Interactive Sydney from maps and photos
title.zh: 用地图与照片构建可交互的悉尼三维场景

summary.en: The author reports building an interactive Sydney scene with zoom, orbit and lighting controls from maps and real photos.
summary.zh: 作者展示了以地图和实景照片为输入、支持缩放、环绕和光影切换的悉尼三维场景。

workflow.en: Combine geographic references and photos with Blender and Three.js; the author reports one conversation.
workflow.zh: 组合地图与实景照片，使用 Blender 和 Three.js；作者称在一次会话中完成。

limitations.en: Scope and geographic accuracy were not independently checked; full prompt, source files and cost are not provided in this post.
limitations.zh: 未独立核验覆盖范围和地理精度；该帖未提供完整提示词、工程文件或成本。

title.en: Figma design from brand identity to pages
title.zh: 用 Figma 完成品牌与页面设计

summary.en: The author describes using Astra with Figma for brand identity and page design, accompanied by a video.
summary.zh: 作者描述用 Astra 配合 Figma 完成品牌与页面设计，并附视频。

workflow.en: Use Figma as the working design environment; exact connection method and prompting are not disclosed in the post.
workflow.zh: 在 Figma 中进行设计；该帖未披露具体连接方式和提示词。

limitations.en: Read through X’s English translation of the Japanese original; the BI interpretation and implementation details need further confirmation.
limitations.zh: 阅读的是 X 对日文原帖的英语翻译；BI 的具体含义及实现细节仍需进一步确认。

summary.en: The author demonstrates a drawing and states that Astra produced it through computer-use mouse operations.
summary.zh: 作者展示绘画结果，并说明 Astra 通过电脑操作中的鼠标动作完成。

workflow.en: Ask the agent to draw through the application UI; the post does not name the drawing application.
workflow.zh: 让智能体通过软件界面操作绘画；该帖未明确绘画软件名称。

limitations.en: Read through X’s English translation of the Japanese original; exact prompt, input assets and application are not disclosed.
limitations.zh: 阅读的是 X 对日文原帖的英语翻译；具体提示词、输入素材及软件未披露。

title.en: Buildable brick models and Blender renders
title.zh: 可搭建的积木模型与 Blender 渲染

summary.en: The author reports designing real brick models in Bricklink Studio and rendering a 4K video in Blender; the post links to parts lists.
summary.zh: 作者称用 Bricklink Studio 设计真实积木模型，再用 Blender 渲染 4K 视频；原帖附零件清单链接。

workflow.en: Design with discrete brick parts first, then render the models in Blender.
workflow.zh: 先用实际积木零件建模，再将模型交给 Blender 渲染。

limitations.en: Linked parts lists and physical buildability have not been independently checked; the exact prompt is not supplied.
limitations.zh: 未独立核验链接中的零件清单及实际可搭建性；未提供准确提示词。

title.en: Basketball team recognition in visual labeling
title.zh: 视觉标注中的篮球队伍识别

summary.en: The author reports distinguishing Celtics and Knicks players in home and away settings, with a video and a linked detection discussion.
summary.zh: 作者用视频展示区分凯尔特人和尼克斯球员，并称主客场均适用；帖中引用了检测分析讨论。

workflow.en: Use visual context to identify team membership; the quoted discussion also discusses bounding boxes.
workflow.zh: 结合画面信息识别队伍归属；引用讨论还涉及目标检测框。

limitations.en: This is an author demonstration, not a benchmark; no dataset, measured accuracy or complete prompt is provided in this post.
limitations.zh: 这是作者演示而非基准测试；该帖未提供数据集、准确率或完整提示词。
